decisions.reason: As a large, experienced German machinery producer, the firm has strong related knowledge in industrial printing and enough R&D capacity to refine a high-resolution piezo inkjet printer rather than withdraw it after only one year.

This software module extends the firm's existing digital inline variable-data printing portfolio very directly, so absorptive capacity is high and early commercialization learning is likely to support retention.

An inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces is closely adjacent to the firm's established coding and marking know-how, making it likely that management keeps it on the market and improves it through accumulated application knowledge.
